SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3862
Date 19/7/32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Deputy Commissioner (Crime)'s
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of the attached petition.

July 17, 1932.

Major K.M. Bourne.

Sir,

I beg to state that a man named Wu Chi Chong
(吴炽昌), native of Kiangpeh (nicknamed The Kiangpeh
Young Master), employed in the Sun Sun Dancing Hall,
keeps a big motor car (No. 784) and lives an extravagant
life with the proceeds of his fraudulent practices.

In consequence of the recent military operations
here I was thrown out of employment 4 months ago, and
in the beginning of June I was introduced to Wu Chi Chong
(吴炽昌) through his chauffeur Tang Ah Ling (汤阿林),
when Wu Chi Chong told me that, in case should I desire
to get a position, I should provide myself with a cash
security of $250.00. I replied that on account of the
recent (Sino-Japanese) Conflict and of the loss of my
employment I was really unable to arrange such a large
sum. Then Wu Chi Chong said that, if I could secure a
cash security of $100, I should get a position with a
remuneration of $100 per mensem, and a cash security of
$50, a monthly remuneration of $50, and that, if I were
to pay the money this day, I should be given the position
the next day. I trusted his words and succeeded in
securing a loan of $250, $50 each from three of my friends,
Hsia Wan Foh (夏文福), Ko Wan Tsai (谷文彩) and Li Chung
Fah (李春法) and $100 from my relatives. In the beginning
of June I with three friends went to the Sun Sun Dancing
Hall and handed the money personally to Wu Chi Chong who

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 3862
日期 1932年7月19日

上海公共租界工部局警务处
副总监（罪案）办公室
总监办公室。

所附诉状之译文。

1932年7月17日。

K.M. Bourne 少校。

先生：

谨陈述如下：有一名为吴炽昌（Wu Chi Chong，江苏北部人，绰号“江北少爷”）者，受雇于仙乐斯舞厅，拥有一辆大型汽车（牌号 784），并靠其欺诈所得过着奢侈的生活。

由于近期本地军事行动，我于四个月前失业。六月初，经其司机汤阿林（Tang Ah Ling）介绍，我结识了吴炽昌。当时吴炽昌告诉我，若我想谋得职位，需缴纳现金保证金 250.00 元。我回答说，鉴于近期的（中日）冲突以及我失业的状况，实在无法筹措如此巨额款项。随后吴炽昌表示，若能提供 100 元现金保证金，即可获得月薪 100 元的职位；若提供 50 元现金保证金，则月薪为 50 元；且若当日付款，次日即可上岗。我轻信其言，成功向三位朋友夏文福（Hsia Wan Foh）、谷文彩（Ko Wan Tsai）和李春法（Li Chung Fah）各借款 50 元，并向亲戚借款 100 元，共计 250 元。六月初，我与三位朋友前往仙乐斯舞厅，将钱亲手交给吴炽昌，他

pages.en:
- 2 -
who told us to call on him the next evening when he
would recommend us to our respective positions. We
called again the next day but were told through Wu Chi
Chong's chauffeur that we should wait for a few days
more. We went there over ten times afterwards and each
time we were sent away under one pretext or the other.
As we were hard pressed by pecuniary and other circum-
stances, we could not wait any longer, so we managed
to see Wu Chi Chong and argued with him. Realising that
he was no longer trusted he returned $100 to me and
promised to pay back the other $150 two days later. All
this took place at the end of June.
At 7.30 p.m. on July 15 I visited again the Sun
Sun Dancing Hall and insisted upon the return of the
remainder of the money. I waited there until after 12
midnight when Wu Chi Chong's chauffeur conveyed his master's
words to me that I should call for the money at the chauf-
feur's home at 8 a.m. the next day. I went there at the
appointed time but the chauffeur had gone out. I proceeded
there again at 11.30 a.m. on the same day when the chauffeur
was not at home but his wife and a male and another female
whom, I learned, were the chauffeur's sister and her husband,
were there. Without any reason whatever these three
persons attacked me and tore my clothing. I was assaulted,
yet I was accused of assaulting them. Just then the
chauffeur returned home and at once reported the matter
to his master who had me taken to the Sinza Police Station
at 11.45 a.m. on July 16. At the Station I was not allowed
to speak a word, slapped several times by a foreigner and
a gateman and shut up in a room. Is it just that I should
have been so insulted? I have therefore to lay these
facts before you with the request that you will be kind
enough to have my grievance redressed and justice upheld.
Ko Kung Sung (谷根生)
alias
Ko Dah Kwei (谷大奎).
pages.zh:
- 2 -
让我们次日晚再来，届时他将推荐我们就任各自职位。次日我们再次前往，但通过吴炽昌的司机传话，让我们再等几天。此后我们又去了十多次，每次都被以各种借口打发走。由于受到经济及其他境况的逼迫，我们无法再等待，于是设法见到吴炽昌并与他理论。意识到不再被信任后，他退还了我 100 元，并承诺两天后归还其余 150 元。这一切发生在六月底。
7月15日晚上7点30分，我再次来到仙乐斯舞厅，坚持要求归还剩余款项。我一直等到午夜12点过后，吴炽昌的司机传达其主人的话，让我次日上午8点到司机家中取款。我在约定时间前往，但司机已外出。同日中午11点30分，我再次前往，司机仍不在家，但其妻子、一名男子和另一名女子在场，后得知该男女分别为司机的妹妹及其丈夫。这三个人毫无理由地攻击我，并撕破我的衣服。我遭到殴打，却被反指控殴打他们。就在此时，司机回家，立即向其主人报告此事，主人遂于7月16日上午11点45分将我带至新闸捕房。在捕房内，我不被允许说一句话，遭一名外人和一名门警扇了数个耳光，并被关进一间屋子。遭受如此侮辱，难道公正吗？因此，我将上述事实呈报给您，恳请您惠予伸张正义，平息冤屈。
谷根生（Ko Kung Sung）
又名
谷大奎（Ko Dah Kwei）。

Burkill Road.

Tang Ah Ling (湯阿林), chauffeur, residing at No.634
Chengtu Road and Avenue Road.

Ko Kung Sung (谷根生), residing at No.7 Myburgh Road,
native of Weihaiwei, Shantung, age 45, formerly in
the employ of Capt. W.H. Dent, for 4 years, and
employed as a C.P.W. for over ten years.

吴炽昌（Wu Chi Chong），住大同路与伯基路 639 号。

汤阿林（Tang Ah Ling），司机，住成都路与爱文义路 634 号。

谷根生（Ko Kung Sung），住迈尔西爱路 7 号，山东威海卫人，年龄 45 岁，曾受雇于 W.H. Dent 上尉四年，并担任中央巡捕（C.P.W.）十余年。
